segments.src: Atlanta, Georgia. Nov 3, 2026.
segments.t: 佐治亚州 Atlanta · 2026年11月3日

segments.src: ATLANTA — November 3, 2026 — Kwontified, a marketplace management agency for consumer brands, today announced the launch of Perspectives, its articles on kwontified.com, and the Kwontified Briefing, a newsletter for brands that sell on Amazon, Walmart, Target and other marketplaces.
segments.t: 亚特兰大 — 2026 年 11 月 3 日 — 面向消费品牌的电商平台运营代理机构 Kwontified 今天宣布推出 Perspectives（kwontified.com 上的文章栏目）和 Kwontified Briefing，一份面向在Amazon、Walmart、Target 及其他电商平台销售的品牌的电子简报。

segments.src: Perspectives publishes analysis by managing partners Elaine Kwon and Jordan Taylor on retail media, marketplace operations and the shift to AI shopping assistants. At launch, 913 articles are available at kwontified.com/perspectives.
segments.t: Perspectives 发布管理合伙人 Elaine Kwon 与 Jordan Taylor 撰写的分析，涵盖零售媒体、电商平台运营以及向 AI 购物助手的转变。上线之初，kwontified.com/perspectives 已提供 913 篇文章。

segments.src: The Kwontified Briefing arrives by email once a month. Each issue leads with one finding brands can act on, followed by short briefs on the news that matters and links to new Kwontified articles. Readers can subscribe at kwontified.com/subscribe.
segments.t: Kwontified Briefing 每月通过电子邮件发送一次。每期以一项品牌可据以行动的发现开篇，随后是对重要新闻的简短解读，以及 Kwontified 新文章的链接。读者可在 kwontified.com/subscribe 订阅。

segments.src: Both are written for the people who run brands on marketplaces:
segments.t: 两者都是为在电商平台上经营品牌的人而写：

segments.src: Retail media and advertising, including how Amazon, Walmart and Target are rebuilding ad buying around AI agents.
segments.t: 零售媒体与广告，包括 Amazon、Walmart 和 Target 如何围绕 AI 智能体重构广告购买。

segments.src: Retail events, with forecasts before major sales and an honest grade of those forecasts afterward.
segments.t: 零售大促，包括重大促销前的预测，以及事后对这些预测的如实评分。

segments.src: Marketplace operations, from inventory and fees to unauthorized resellers and new marketplaces.
segments.t: 电商平台运营，从库存和费用，到未授权经销商和新的电商平台。

segments.src: “Brands are making more decisions, faster, with less clear information from the platforms they sell on,” said Jordan Taylor, managing partner at Kwontified. “Perspectives and the Briefing share what we see across the accounts we manage, in plain terms, so brand leaders can act on it.”
segments.t: “品牌要做的决策更多、更快，而它们所在的销售平台给出的信息却更不清晰，”Kwontified 管理合伙人 Jordan Taylor 表示，“Perspectives 和 Briefing 用平实的语言分享我们在所管理账户中观察到的情况，让品牌负责人能够据此行动。”

segments.src: About Kwontified
segments.t: 关于 Kwontified

segments.src: Kwontified is a marketplace management agency that runs Amazon, Walmart, Target Plus and other marketplaces for consumer brands. Founded in 2016, it is headquartered in Atlanta. Learn more at kwontified.com.
segments.t: Kwontified 是一家电商平台运营代理机构，为消费品牌运营Amazon、Walmart、Target Plus 及其他电商平台。公司成立于 2016 年，总部位于 Atlanta。了解更多请访问 kwontified.com。
